# deed_telemetry_binding (Resource)

A Deed telemetry binding: a named, admin-authored query template that users run against entities of the listed kinds, with typed parameters filled from entity fields (Deed's docs/TELEMETRY.md). Role `chart` draws it on the entity page, `health` turns a scalar into health with thresholds, `edge_rate` measures traffic on a relationship type for the map's traffic overlay, `link` opens the backend (Grafana). Installation-wide; requires an installation `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Health from node_exporter: CPU busy per host (instance label = the entity's hostname).
resource "deed_telemetry_binding" "cpu" {
  name        = "host-cpu"
  title       = "CPU busy"
  integration = deed_integration.prometheus.name
  kinds       = ["vm", "server"]
  query       = "100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=\"idle\",instance=\"{{instance}}\"}[{{window}}])))"
  params      = [{ name = "instance", type = "label", from = "/spec/hostname", required = true }]
  unit        = "percent"
  role        = "health"
  thresholds  = { warning = 80, critical = 95 }
}

# A chart: container memory (cAdvisor) by container name.
resource "deed_telemetry_binding" "container_memory" {
  name        = "container-memory"
  title       = "Container memory"
  integration = deed_integration.prometheus.name
  kinds       = ["service", "container"]
  query       = "sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{name=\"{{container}}\"})"
  params      = [{ name = "container", type = "label", from = "/metadata/name" }]
  shape       = "timeseries"
  unit        = "bytes"
}

# Traffic overlay: Caddy request rate on routes_to relationships. Edge-rate parameters read either end of the
# relationship: "to:/metadata/name" is the site service the proxy routes to (named after its host name).
resource "deed_telemetry_binding" "caddy_rate" {
  name              = "caddy-request-rate"
  integration       = deed_integration.prometheus.name
  query             = "sum(rate(caddy_http_requests_total{host=\"{{host}}\"}[{{window}}]))"
  params            = [{ name = "host", type = "label", from = "to:/metadata/name" }]
  unit              = "req/s"
  role              = "edge_rate"
  relationship_type = "routes_to"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `integration` (String) Integration name or ID (for example `deed_integration.prometheus.name`).
- `name` (String) Unique name.

### Optional

- `freshness_seconds` (Number) How long a result counts as fresh (15–86400, default 300).
- `kinds` (Set of String) Entity kinds the binding applies to. Omit for every kind.
- `params` (Attributes List) Typed parameters (at most 16). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `query` (String) Query template with `{{param}}` placeholders and the built-ins `{{window}}` and `{{step}}` (PromQL, LogQL, a Grafana search, …). Parameters are typed and validated before substitution.
- `relationship_type` (String) Relationship type an `edge_rate` binding measures.
- `role` (String) `chart` (default; `link` for link-shaped bindings), `health`, `edge_rate` or `link`.
- `shape` (String) Result shape: `scalar` (default), `timeseries`, `table` or `link`.
- `thresholds` (Attributes) Warning and critical thresholds (required for `health`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--thresholds))
- `title` (String) Title shown in the UI. Defaults to `name`.
- `unit` (String) Display unit, e.g. `percent`, `bytes`, `req/s`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Binding ID.
- `integration_id` (String) Integration ID.

<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Required:

- `name` (String) Placeholder name.
- `type` (String) `label`, `string`, `int`, `duration` or `subject`.

Optional:

- `default` (String) Value when the field is empty.
- `from` (String) JSON pointer into the entity the value comes from, e.g. `/spec/hostname`, `/metadata/name` or `/metadata/labels/instance`. Edge-rate bindings read either end of the relationship with a `from:` or `to:` prefix (`to:/metadata/name`).
- `pattern` (String) Extra RE2 the value must match.
- `required` (Boolean) Skip the binding for entities without a value.


<a id="nestedatt--thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `thresholds`

Optional:

- `critical` (Number) Critical threshold.
- `direction` (String) `above` (default: higher is worse) or `below`.
- `warning` (Number) Warning threshold.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_telemetry_binding.cpu host-cpu # name or ID
```
